t: I saw it myself. {whom} went straight up into the air like a sack of feathers
people get picked up off the ground now. that's a thing that happens here
I watched {whom} get flung like a stone from a sling. I'm not sleeping tonight
they say {whom} got thrown halfway across the valley. I half believe it
thrown, they said. people don't just fall UP, so something did the throwing
somebody flew, somebody fell, and the story grows every time it's told
it set {whom} down gentle as you'd put down an egg. I saw the whole thing
the ground shook and there was a crash you could feel in your teeth. I was right there
did you feel that crash earlier? whatever it was, I'm glad I wasn't under it
food just appeared. out of nowhere, right where we needed it. I saw it land
they're saying the food in the square just showed up on its own
we were fed when we had nothing. I know a gift when I eat one
free food, sure. and I say someone just miscounted the baskets
the sky came down on {whom} and there's nothing left but scorched grass. I saw it
I can't stop seeing it. one flash and {whom} was just gone
they say {whom} was struck down out of a clear sky. clear sky, no storm
struck down for something, mark me. the sky doesn't miss
lightning kills somebody every few years. it's sad, it's not a message
a whole tree ripped up by the roots, right in front of me. roots and all
you seen that tree by the ridge? something tore it out like a weed
the wall mended itself. I watched the crack close up like it was never there
broken one day, whole the next, and no one lifted a tool. explain that
the ground rolled under my feet like water. I thought that was the end of us
you felt the shaking too, right? the whole village felt it
the earth doesn't shake itself. someone shook it
{whom} is gone. I was there. I don't want to talk about the details
did you hear about {whom}? terrible thing. terrible
we lost {whom}. the fire feels smaller tonight
a baby came through the whole thing healthy and yelling. that's the best news all season
the bushes went heavy with fruit overnight. I picked till my basket broke
everything's blooming at once out east. go see it before the birds get it
the land doesn't bloom like that on its own. that's a thank-you or an ask
good soil, good rain, good luck. no mystery in a berry
